title: Meridian Forest Services
description: Meridian Forest Services Limited is a progressive natural resource consulting company that offers a range of services including forest engineering, silviculture, tenure management, strategic planning, geomatics, wildlife and danger tree assessment, and project management. The company caters to a diverse clientele, including First Nations, industry stakeholders, private forest landowners, and government entities. Committed to safety, Meridian is Safe Certified through the BC Forest Safety Council, ensuring a secure work environment.
